Every book on manifesting skips this part. You can say the affirmations, visualize the goal, do everything the system tells you — and still feel an invisible force pushing back. That's not you failing at the technique. That's a counter intention, sitting in your DNA and your memory, from this lifetime and before.

You were never broken. You were just carrying something that was never yours to carry.

This is why the affirmations alone never worked. You weren't lacking discipline. You were carrying someone else's fear.
